email.subject: Stride Works Fitness: mobile visitors can't book
email.body:
Hi Luis,

I checked Stride Works Fitness's site. Two issues are likely costing you members: it's not mobile-friendly, and there's no online booking. Most people searching for a gym do it on their phone, often right after a workout or a search for "gyms near me" - if the page is hard to use and they can't book a class on the spot, they leave and try a competitor instead.

The site also has no click-to-call button and doesn't list your hours, which adds friction for anyone trying to reach you quickly.

I fix issues like these for a flat fee. Happy to do a free 10-minute walkthrough showing exactly what's going on and what I'd change - no obligation either way.

Worth a quick look?

Alex
